title: Geometry Dash
shortDescription: Geometry Dash helps define a PC (Windows) arcade and platformer and rhythm path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced arcade and platformer and rhythm option to the PC (Windows) discovery path.
Uses structured metadata as provenance rather than imported review copy.
